rna.text: Kodolaag, a demon performer of the Cult of Rakdos, goes into Zita's effigy shop and clumsily tries to chat her up, and he later drives off a heckling Azorius elocutor with blight parchment.

When an Azorius arrester takes Zita away for defacing a building and slandering a Grand Arbiter, Kodolaag and Olrich visit the precognition mage Lucinka, who gives them a box and instructions for freeing her.

At the prison they find Zita under a spell that makes prisoners praise their imprisonment, and Kodolaag draws every guard on blight parchment and tears the pages, incapacitating them, so Zita escapes into the crowd.

Kodolaag and Olrich are put to forced labor at the Exner prison site, where Kodolaag shatters the bloodfray stone and triggers a massive riot that frees thousands of prisoners, and Lucinka tells them they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity.
